sources.ref: FiiO Control web app 4.4.6 of 2026-11-21 (https://fiiocontrol.fiio.com): its model list, and the filter types, gain range and presets it gives this model

meta.notes: FiiO Control added it in 4.4.3, as a beta device, and gives it what it gives the Game Engine: the same filter types, gain range, presets and controls. FiiO Control asks the device for its band count; 10 is the app's default layout, not a confirmed count for this model.
